title: Good. I went to her garden.
scene: 回家被问今天怎么样，讲奶奶的菜园。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: How was the visit to Grandma's?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Good. I went to her garden.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: One big red one. I went to show Grandma.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She said it was her favorite kind.
